# UNCANNY

> UNCANNY — Universal DLSS 5 Neural Remaster Engine for Windows PC games and emulators.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/coye2/UNCANNY

UNCANNY is an independent real-time remaster middleware project. Its scope includes DLSS 5 / Feature-18 neural rendering, adaptive Clean 1–3 reconstruction stages, Motion Guard, Ghosting Guard, REVENANT persistent asset reconstruction, legacy x86→x64 neural transport, a Control Deck, diagnostics, installer safety and rollback.

Current public candidate: v0.19.0-alpha.1 — release-alpha.rc2.hotfix.2 — ABI 140.

Primary platform focus: Windows + NVIDIA RTX.
Primary graphics API focus: Direct3D 9, 10, 11 and 12.
Primary emulator target: PCSX2.

Important evidence rule: provider files, a successful IPC fixture, copied source frames, generated PNGs and enabled UI states are not counted as neural/remaster success by themselves. Neural success requires FeatureCreate/FeatureEvaluate plus current-frame return/presentation evidence. REVENANT success requires capture, real inference, validated replacement, reload/binding, rendered use and safe persistence/restore.
